as_of.initialization_note: Arlequino explicitly prioritized finding an organizer because he has many tasks to delegate. Rena used the current caravan/merchant contact to obtain a broader event-operations referral. The couple has reached independent coordinator candidate Raden in Dwargon; he is hearing scope but is not hired. The Eurazania refugee inquiry remains active and queued for continuation after this contact.

processes.objective: Find an organizer/coordinator for concerts and broader creative/operational work.
processes.current_state: Rena obtained a causal referral from the caravan/merchant dispatcher to Raden, an independent Dwargon organizer/coordinator candidate with plausible experience in venue coordination, schedules, staff, suppliers, permissions, ticketing/front-of-house and public-event operations. Arlequino and Rena reached his office. Raden is willing to hear the scope before deciding whether he can take the work. He is NOT hired; availability, suitability, compensation and exact mandate remain unresolved.
constraints: Scope is broader than one concert.
Do not treat referral as successful hire.
Arlequino must define his own requirements; do not invent them.
Price, availability, authority and acceptance require explicit in-world agreement.
advance_when: Terms are negotiated or the candidate declines.

processes.objective: Determine through causal in-world channels where Eurazania evacuees were sent and where they can currently be found.
processes.current_state: Partial result remains: evacuation traffic was split; several large civilian groups moved northeast toward Jura/Tempest direction and others through temporary camps/secondary routes. Exact current distribution and individual names remain unresolved. The next likely source is the Free Guild/adventurer network, but the couple temporarily prioritizes the organizer meeting at Arlequino's request.
processes.location_context: Dwargon with inquiry targets potentially outside Dwargon
constraints: No omniscient access to evacuation records.
Do not infer the condition of 18 Old Garden Street from city-wide destruction alone.
dependencies: Free Guild/adventurer-network records for escort or refugee intake information.
Gate/route dispatch ledgers for convoy identifiers and intermediate stops.
advance_when: Organizer meeting ends or is paused.
Rena or Arlequino resumes the Free Guild/gate route.

processes.objective: Begin gathering realistic new-home options for Rena and Arlequino.
processes.current_state: No property contact or option is established. The destruction news raises urgency but does not establish the old home's condition or the new-home city.
constraints: Exact budget is unresolved; family funds are approximately ~358g.
Final purchase decision is not delegated.
Do not assume 18 Old Garden Street was destroyed without a specific source.
advance_when: Rena finishes or pauses higher-priority organizer/refugee tasks.
She encounters a plausible property-information channel.

processes.objective: Develop and stage «Гвазимодо» with the Dwargon students.
processes.current_state: Casting is complete. Students continue self-organized rehearsal and production work. Bren continues refining availability and plausible rehearsal blocks; no final schedule is fixed because the concert date remains unknown.
constraints: Dain remains the tree as punishment unless changed.
Concert date is not yet fixed.
advance_when: Bren materially advances or completes scheduling.

processes.objective: Simulate continuing consequences of the capital's destruction.
processes.current_state: Arlequino and Rena know the capital was destroyed and know a partial evacuation pattern through a Dwargon caravan-network source. Exact current refugee distribution, exact home-level damage and Carrion's true fate remain unresolved/restricted.
constraints: Do not invent exact casualty numbers or complete refugee destinations.
Do not infer the condition of 18 Old Garden Street from city-wide destruction alone.
Carrion's true survival remains restricted until canonically revealed.
advance_when: Refugees, officials, traders, guilds and messengers move.
Arlequino or Rena interacts with affected networks.

maintenance.on_substantial_time_advance: Review every relevant active process and persist justified partial progress, blocking reason, completion or failure.
